case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 42. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

You wrote that your CNC machines are ready and that you want to get this job onto the shop floor. Option A is built to do that, and it gives your shop a defined job to fill.

Several bidders are competing for this pump shaft, and the award goes to the best overall package. On that basis, Option A is the package we can approve: it sets out the price, payment and lead time in one clear proposal, and the points below show where your offer stands.

On quality:
Your quality was 1863 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70210@2026Q3).

On competing offers:
Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).

On material costs:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

Our proposal: unit price EUR 26.61; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.

We would like to give this work to a partner we know and have worked with. Please look at Option A and let us know where you can meet it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Hallo, thanks for the clear numbers; the 14 days payment is good for us, and I see the material drop and the other offer you mentioned. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our current defect rate for you is about 1200 ppm. We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. 

Our Angebot is a price of €30.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

You wrote that you need to clarify internally before coming back to us on price, and that faster payment is welcome. Option A gives your shop exactly that: payment in a short term, which helps your cash flow, on a clearly defined job for your CNC machines.

Several bidders are still in the running, and the award goes to the best overall package, which we cannot promise in advance. Option A is the package we can approve, and we would like to see it with you. We appreciate the care you took in checking our points and the open way you answered.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 26.87; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 28.05; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

Since your answer is waiting on an internal approval, here is a short paragraph that can be approved as it stands: Option A gives Zerspanung Dralveck a defined pump shaft job for the new HX series, with a clear unit price, payment in a short term and a fixed lead time. It is a straightforward proposal from a customer that values reliable work from a family firm.

Could you please take Option A up for that approval and let us know the outcome?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. Hallo, I looked at Option A and we can drop the price to 28.00 EUR. 

Our current offer is a price of €28.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. Getting paid in 14 days is great for our cash flow, so I'm happy to give you a better price for it. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

You say there are still several bidders, but without hard proof I can't just drop the price more. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work together with you and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to offer you a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 52 days.

Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Ms Procházková,

You wrote that you want to prove yourselves as a reliable, long-term partner. Option A is built around that: the best payment terms of the three and a clear basis for planning your work with us on the HX series.

On quality:
Your quality was 980 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70240@2026Q3).

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 25.99; payment 90 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 25.84; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 25.76; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

Option A is the package we can approve, because the quality record and the movement in the surcharge do not support the price in your offer, while Option A gives you the most favourable payment terms. Several bidders are competing for this shaft, and the award goes to the best overall package. We cannot promise it to anyone in advance.

For your management, in short: Option A gives Strojírna Hrvelec the most favourable payment terms of our three options, and a dependable, well-planned supply relationship for the HX series. Please take Option A to your management for approval.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
